verified_facts.text: The Sonnenalp Hotel is located in the heart of Vail Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp is located in the heart of Vail Village, one of Colorado's most iconic mountain destinations.

verified_facts.text: All suites and hotel rooms have a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: all with a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village

verified_facts.text: Each suite has a bedroom and a living room area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite has a bedroom and a well-appointed, delightfully comfortable living room area.

verified_facts.text: Many suites feature gas fireplaces, balconies and heated marble bathroom floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many suites feature separate living areas, gas fireplaces, balconies, heated marble bathroom floors, and views of Gore Creek or Vail Village.

verified_facts.text: The hotel grew from a modest lodge its founders established 40 years ago.
verified_facts.excerpt: The modest lodge our founders established 40 years ago led to the luxury hotel and resort that rests at the heart of Vail Valley today

verified_facts.text: Swiss Chalet serves Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette and schnitzel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swiss Chalet at Sonnenalp offers authentic Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette, schnitzel, and alpine specialties inspired by traditional European recipes.

verified_facts.text: Swiss Chalet reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served on Ludwig's glass-enclosed terrace overlooking Gore Creek.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp's bountiful European style breakfast is served on the beautiful glass enclosed Ludwig’s terrace overlooking Gore Creek.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast at Ludwig's offers a full menu, a hot and cold buffet and traditional pastries.
verified_facts.excerpt: daily breakfast in Ludwig’s featuring a full menu as well as a tempting hot and cold buffet and a large selection of traditional pastries

verified_facts.text: King's Club serves cocktails with live entertainment beside a fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor exquisite cocktails accompanied by live entertainment, all set against the backdrop of a roaring fireplace.

verified_facts.text: Bully Ranch is a casual restaurant with Western charm serving Colorado-inspired dishes and burgers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bully Ranch offers indoor and outdoor dining along with a menu featuring Colorado-inspired dishes, burgers, salads, and signature specialties.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a heated indoor and outdoor pool with a riverfront sun deck and a summer pool bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated indoor & outdoor tranquility pool with riverfront sun deck and summer pool bar.

verified_facts.text: Indoor and outdoor whirlpools look out over Gore Creek.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indoor and outdoor co-ed whirlpools offering the best views of the Gore creek.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a cafe and an oxygen bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa Cafe & Oxygen Bar

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a Kids Club with arts and crafts and outdoor excursions.
verified_facts.excerpt: From engaging arts and crafts sessions to exhilarating outdoor excursions, children are immersed in experiences that are both educational and fun.

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests have preferred access to tee times at the Sonnenalp Club golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sonnenalp hotel guests have preferred access to golf tee times.

verified_facts.text: The Sonnenalp Club golf course is in Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Club is perfectly located in the sun drenched valley of Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village.

verified_facts.text: The golf course is a 7,100-yard championship links-style course.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Golf Club is a championship, 7,100-yard links-style course

verified_facts.text: The golf season runs from early April to late October.
verified_facts.excerpt: This down valley location gives our members and guests an extended playing season stretching from early April to late October.

verified_facts.text: The Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has a private lounge with secure lockers at Gorsuch Ski Cafe.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sonnenalp Hotel proudly offers our exclusive Sonnenalp Ski Concierge, boasting a private lounge, secure lockers and personalized service located at Gorsuch Ski Café.

verified_facts.text: Gorsuch Ski Cafe is 50 steps from Gondola One.
verified_facts.excerpt: in a private setting just 50 steps from Gondola One

verified_facts.text: The ski concierge offers ski, snowboard and helmet rentals and demos through Gorsuch.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has partnered with the experts at Gorsuch to provide top of the line rentals and demos for skis, snowboards and helmets

verified_facts.text: Sonnenalp guides lead guided hikes and nature walks in summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our professionally guided walks & hikes are uplifting, informative, surprisingly relaxing and provide just the right amount of challenge for any skill level.

verified_facts.text: Guided winter hiking and snowshoeing tours are offered for ages 13 and up, with private tours for all ages.

verified_facts.text: Summer guided activities run through August 31.

verified_facts.excerpt: The ability to experience Vail without needing to drive is one of the unique advantages of staying at Sonnenalp
